title: Your work. One command center.
subtitle: Projects · Agents · GUS · Plugins
lines: Meet Zana: one place to organize your projects, launch AI agents, and keep track of their work.
Let's walk through a project, then explore GUS tickets and custom plugins.

captions.text: Meet Zana: one place to organize your projects, launch AI agents, and keep track of their work.
Let's walk through a project, then explore GUS tickets and custom plugins.

title: Start with a project
lines: Start with the plus button beside Projects.
Add a local folder, clone from Git, or connect a remote project.

captions.text: Start with the plus button beside Projects.
Add a local folder, clone from Git, or connect a remote project.

title: Give the work a home
lines: Choose your folder and select Add project.
Your project appears in the sidebar, giving your agents a clear place to work.

captions.text: Choose your folder and select Add project.
Your project appears in the sidebar, giving your agents a clear place to work.

title: Choose your agent
lines: Open New agent from the project.
Choose a Modern conversation or a CLI agent, then select your installed provider and model.

captions.text: Open New agent from the project.
Choose a Modern conversation or a CLI agent, then select your installed provider and model.

title: Describe a concrete outcome
lines: Give the agent a clear objective and constraints.
Here, we ask for three milestones and an acceptance checklist for a fictional task dashboard.
Select Send to start the work.

captions.text: Give the agent a clear objective and constraints.
Here, we ask for three milestones and an acceptance checklist for a fictional task dashboard.
Select Send to start the work.

title: The agent gets to work
lines: The thread shows the agent working, with a place to send follow-ups or stop the task.

captions.text: The thread shows the agent working, with a place to send follow-ups or stop the task.

title: See where your attention is needed
lines: Open Agents for a view across your work, and filter by project or task.
The board separates Needs you, Working, Idle, and Done, so you can spot what needs attention.

captions.text: Open Agents for a view across your work, and filter by project or task.
The board separates Needs you, Working, Idle, and Done, so you can spot what needs attention.

title: Inspect the work, then steer it
lines: Open a thread and expand its activity to inspect commands, file changes, and progress.
You can add a follow-up whenever the task needs direction.

captions.text: Open a thread and expand its activity to inspect commands, file changes, and progress.
You can add a follow-up whenever the task needs direction.

title: Review the result
lines: The agent has created the plan and summarized the result.
Review the output before moving on to the next milestone.

captions.text: The agent has created the plan and summarized the result.
Review the output before moving on to the next milestone.

title: Keep your GUS work in view
lines: With the GUS plugin configured for your account, My work brings your tickets into Zana.
Choose a sprint and use the Me filter to focus on your own work, or inspect the team's board.

captions.text: With the GUS plugin configured for your account, My work brings your tickets into Zana.
Choose a sprint and use the Me filter to focus on your own work, or inspect the team's board.

title: Go from a ticket to an agent
lines: Open a ticket to review its status, details, and chatter.
Watch tickets you want to follow. Work with agent opens a draft with the ticket context, ready for your instructions.

captions.text: Open a ticket to review its status, details, and chatter.
Watch tickets you want to follow. Work with agent opens a draft with the ticket context, ready for your instructions.

title: Make Zana your own
lines: Plugins add tools to your command center.
To build your own, open Plugins and choose New plugin.

captions.text: Plugins add tools to your command center.
To build your own, open Plugins and choose New plugin.

title: Describe the tool you want
lines: Describe what you want in plain language.
Our example is a Focus Board with three daily tasks, checkboxes, and a completion count.

captions.text: Describe what you want in plain language.
Our example is a Focus Board with three daily tasks, checkboxes, and a completion count.

title: Build on the app's existing surfaces
lines: The built-in Plugin Guide shows where a plugin can appear, including panels, project views, and thread tools.
An agent can build and verify the plugin. Review it before installing it locally.

captions.text: The built-in Plugin Guide shows where a plugin can appear, including panels, project views, and thread tools.
An agent can build and verify the plugin. Review it before installing it locally.

title: Start a project. Give it a goal.
subtitle: Launch an agent. Stay in control.
lines: That's the workflow: organize the project, delegate the task, and monitor the result.
Keep your tickets nearby, and shape Zana around the way you work.

captions.text: That's the workflow: organize the project, delegate the task, and monitor the result.
